user.title: Add Sol-Ark 15K
user.description: Configure one Waveshare Modbus TCP endpoint for one Sol-Ark 15K inverter. Setup performs a read-only test of holding register 183.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read Sol-Ark register 183. Check the gateway, TCP port, RS485 wiring, serial settings, and whether another monitor is contending for the bus.

abort.already_configured: This Modbus endpoint is already configured.

init.title: Sol-Ark polling options
init.description: Operational registers are polled separately from slower detail and energy registers. Each successful block is published to Home Assistant immediately. Retry quiet time is used only after a failed Modbus request.
